Package com.hitorro.jsontypesystem.datamapper

Class TransformDSL

java.lang.Object
groovy.lang.GroovyObjectSupport
groovy.lang.Script
com.hitorro.jsontypesystem.datamapper.TransformDSL
All Implemented Interfaces:
groovy.lang.GroovyObject
public abstract class TransformDSL extends groovy.lang.Script
Base class for Groovy DSL transform scripts. Scripts extend this class (configured via CompilerConfiguration) and get all DSL methods available.

DSL operations

 copy "source.title" to "target.title"
 copyAll()
 delete "target.body.mls[0].clean"
 set "target.status", "published"
 mls "target.title", text: gen.fullName(), lang: "en"

 when(source("type") == "article") {
     copy "source.author" to "target.writer"
 }

 loop("source.tags[]") { tag ->
     append "target.categories", tag
 }

      public Object load(String libName)
      Load a library script from the transforms/lib/ directory. The library script should return a Map of name→closure. Usage: def lib = load("common") // loads transforms/lib/common.groovy set "target.slug", lib.slugify("Hello World")

    • deleteIf

      public void deleteIf(String path, groovy.lang.Closure<?> pred)
      Delete a target path only if the closure evaluates truthy against the current value at path. The closure receives the value as a JsonNode (may be null). 
      
 deleteIf("target.status") { it?.textValue() == "draft" }

    • mapArray

      public void mapArray(String path, groovy.lang.Closure<?> transform)
      Element-wise transform over an array at path. The closure is invoked once per element and its return value replaces the element. The path is resolved against the target by default (or source if prefixed). 
      
 mapArray("target.tags") { tag -> tag.textValue().toLowerCase() }

    • ifMissing

      public void ifMissing(String path, Object defaultValue)
      Set a default value at path only if it is currently null or missing. Existing non-null values are left untouched. 
      
 ifMissing "target.status", "draft"

    • coalesce

      public com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode coalesce(String... paths)
      Return the value of the first path whose resolved value is non-null. Paths are checked left-to-right and may be either source.* or target.*. Returns null if every candidate is absent. 
      
 set "target.display", coalesce("source.nickname", "source.name", "target.fallback")
